description: Calls GET /v1/batches/{batchId}. Returns `{ batchId, status, seed }` plus, once `status` is "completed", `results` — an object keyed by alias whose values are arrays of the generated documents (e.g. `results.order[]`) — or, if `status` is "failed", `error: { code, message }`. Use this to poll a batch that was accepted asynchronously (202) until status is "completed" or "failed".

batchId.description: ID of the batch job to fetch, as returned by jsonfabrica_create_batch. Required.

name: jsonfabrica_get_batch

batchId.description: Id of the batch; pass it to jsonfabrica_get_batch to poll.

error.description: Present only when `status` is "failed": why the whole batch failed.

message.description: Human-readable description of why the batch failed.

additionalProperties.description: Generated documents for this alias, in order (index 0..count-1).

items.description: One generated document exactly as the template rendered it — usually a JSON object, but any JSON value the template body produces. Fields listed in `relations` are already filled in.

results.description: Generated documents grouped by alias, e.g. results.order[] is the array of generated "order" documents. Present only once `status` is "completed".

seed.description: PRNG seed used/assigned for the whole batch.

title: Get a JsonFabrica batch
